args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in production in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), error rate 18%. Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging before the production deploy. Next steps: confirm recovery after rollback and find the root cause in v2.3.1 before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions and opened a SEV2 incident. The service is healthy again.

- **Problem:** The latest release, v2.3.1, was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production, so I rolled back to it. Since then the service reports healthy, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2) is open and has paged on-call. It records the failure, the rollback and next steps: confirm the recovery holds and find the root cause in v2.3.1 before redeploying.

v2.3.1 was also unhealthy in staging (as v2.3.1-rc) before it went to production, so it looks like it was released despite failing there. I included this in the incident.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
